facts: Public issuer balance-sheet and summary APIs expose allocations and net liability conventions, but do not independently verify full beneficial ownership, fund NAV realization, bank cash or all remote liabilities.
Overlapping 3-of-6 and 3-of-5 Safes concentrate pricing, minting, upgrades and redemption-asset discretion.
BitGo-labelled reserve account beneficial ownership and bank cash remain unverified; public token balances alone do not prove beneficial reserve ownership.
No verified funded general holder recourse; source code audits and the bounty do not supply recourse for privileged-key/governance actions.
